data: What are the specific hardware and software configurations used to achieve these decoding results?

The caption provides the specific hardware and software configurations used to achieve these decoding results. The figure is a comparison among the decoding results of the MT03 test dataset on a single GeForce GTX TITAN X GPU server under three different searching settings. The x-axis represents the time taken to translate one word on average, while the y-axis represents the BLEU score of translations. The lines represent the performance of three different searching settings: naive beam search, NCP+SN, and ACP+SN. The figure shows two graphs: one without self-normalization and another with self-normalization.
